basis: ModernLayer is an explicitly modern software feature, with no Yamaha circuit equivalent. Its documented current-sample rank offsets must also apply to the now-connected VCA coupling output. This is a scheduling/integration contract, not hardware evidence or a replacement for the original phrase click criteria.
engine_fixture: Source Performance and Pure, 44.1/48/96 kHz, Eco/Standard/HQ, both rank mix endpoints, shared free and per-voice poly MSEG-to-pan. Silent oscillators charge the declared VCA pedestal. Observe the first 2048 internal samples after retirement, including the first inactive sample within a host frame. At each sample compare the consumed raw rank mix with the independently known current MSEG value, existing pan law and post-step coupling state. The observer calls the same four production stages and must equal an unobserved processInternalSample twin bit for bit. A linear, non-looping poly MSEG must advance by actual elapsed internal time, within 1e-12 seconds, with no extra tick at idle deadlines.
ownership_fixture: Compare a live-pan engine with an otherwise identical no-pan reference while routing non-MSEG velocity/key/random sources to a global destination. Keep an older note held and retire the newest. Original scheduled ownership publication must remain exact. Also enable/reroute pan when the inactive voice's modern note age has never been latched, then assign another note before the retired voice's idle deadline: extra tail updates must not consume per-note RNG or trigger mono/poly identity transitions early.
policy_fixture: Pure with a configured nonzero matrix must equal an empty matrix exactly; a zero-amount configured pan route must equal the neutral Source default. Legacy retains its original inactive path even if a prior Source tail left an otherwise unused VCA charge at a policy switch. No live pan destination keeps the existing processing path.
scope: A single shared poly MSEG remains authoritative. Advancing it to drive an audible tail's pan also updates the values seen by any other routes sharing that runner at their scheduled evaluations; this is explicitly not a promise of pan-only audio equality for mixed routes. Global selection timing and note identity/RNG scheduling remain unchanged.
mutations: evaluate after consuming the tail mix
tick again at the scheduled idle call
publish ownership on every extra tail sample
latch note identity/RNG on an unscheduled tail sample
run the tail update in Legacy
enable the modern matrix under Pure
weaken a registered exact or elapsed-time limit
ignore cached pan when the last live pan route is removed
route_removal_amendment: Registered before applying or evaluating the candidate: after a charged Source voice retires, zero, remove or reroute its pan slot while another matrix route remains live. Both rank endpoints must consume exactly zero stale pan starting on the next internal sample, even before the original idle deadline. Existing exact pan and raw-mix bounds apply; no new or weakened numeric tolerance. A cached nonzero pan offset may require one final early evaluation after the last live pan route disappears.
